title: The leak scan passes a short real EC key body with a slash that a period, underscore or hyphen follows, because the path lookahead calls any run of short slash-separated pieces a repository path
goal: kbcommon.leak_hits flags the EC armor label before a single-line body of 20 to 40 base64 characters that holds a slash and that a period, an underscore or a hyphen follows, and still does not flag the label before a repository path

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import kbcommon
d = "-" * 5
arm = d + "BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY" + d
miss = [s for s in (".", "_x", "-x", ".pem") if not any(k == "secret" for k, _ in kbcommon.leak_hits(arm + " CwgQj8C/nbil1bW34cYU" + s))]
print("short slash-containing body not flagged before:", miss)
sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)

import random,sys
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import kbcommon
d="-"*5;arm=d+"BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY"+d
hit=lambda t:any(k=="secret" for k,_ in kbcommon.leak_hits(t))
rnd=random.Random(7);al="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+"
miss=[];total=0
for n in range(20,41,4):
    for suf in (".","_x","-x",".pem"):
        for _ in range(5):
            k=rnd.randint(3,n-4);body="".join(rnd.choice(al) for _ in range(n-1));body=body[:k]+"/"+body[k:]
            total+=1
            if not hit(arm+" "+body+suf):miss.append(n)
paths=["kb/public/intune/profiles.md page","_tools/kbcommon.py in the repo","kb/_self/backlog/BG-aaaaaaaa.json item"]
false=[p for p in paths if hit(arm+" "+p)]
print("short slash bodies not flagged:",len(miss),"of",total,"| repository paths flagged:",false)
sys.exit(1 if miss or false else 0)

clauses.clause: kbcommon.leak_hits flags the EC armor label before a single-line body of 20 to 40 base64 characters that holds a slash and that a period, an underscore or a hyphen follows
still does not flag the label before a repository path

notes: SP-jopt2c3z review (S3, other): BG-nx6jzvop's start lookahead calls a run a path when every slash piece is at most 16 letters or digits, no plus, and a dot, underscore or hyphen follows. Random real-looking bodies of 20 to 40 characters with one slash pass in 6 to 14 percent of cases for 20 to 30 characters and 1 percent at 40; none at 78 or more. Real SEC1 and PKCS8 EC bodies are over 100 characters, so this is a theoretical case. Also: the end line of an armor block counts as a path suffix for a body under about 33 characters. Tension with BG-v5tq4jkz: the fix must separate a path from a body without a fixed segment length. Add cases inside an existing test function of the touched test file: the test-id ceiling is hard, so no new test id.
